title.narrative: Capacity building support for the Humanitarian Aid Commission

description.narrative: 1-ehabilitation and maintenance of the main UNHCR building. 2- Rehabilitation of the media unit. 3- Electronic archiving and networking.

Building the capacities of the staff of the Humanitarian Aid Commission by creating an appropriate work environment and providing emergency networking and information to reduce economic and social waste in the event of disasters.

Ease of obtaining information Documenting the activities of the Commission Feeding and updating social networking sites Strengthening and activating communication and coordination between the various media outlets Quickly providing the competent authorities with reliable data Eliminating inconsistencies in the records of organizations operating at the national and state levels
